title: "Lord, help me remember that I am lovingly formed, not forgotten."
paragraphs: "Lord, help me remember that I am lovingly formed, not forgotten."

When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment.
I stand quietly as dust becomes more than dust. The ground itself seems to hold its breath as life is given—slow, intentional, loving. Nothing is rushed. Nothing is accidental.
If the first human began with such care, what does that say about the care woven into my own beginning—and my becoming still today?
